protocol: BAS Hv default, choose position before start; figure region from game geometry, never GT.
ENTER starts silent static test; wait at least 5 seconds for settled PRE. No automatic 45 s stop in diagnostic mode.
Six deliberate physical impacts: two interior, two near an internal scoring boundary, two outside the silhouette but within the observed board.
Space events at least 6 seconds; keep projection/hardware unchanged. Note actual runtime IDs and independent physical hole locations, not intended positions or AUTO output.
Record every extra audio event separately. Lack of emitted hit is not lack of physical shot. Never seed manual truth from AUTO.
Wait at least 5 seconds after the last action, then ENTER to end, preserve AUTO separately and close normally.
Use explicit binding for health and independent camera labeling. Do not finalize expected categories as observed truth.
